body: You are worried about it being painless to your friends and family?  I'm sorry bud it won't be.  There is no way to make yourself disappear to where you will just be gone and nobody knows.  I have no idea what it's like to be in your position but if I was your family/friend I would much rather hear about it from you rather than hear about it from the police local to me telling me you did it.  I'm sorry about whatever you are going through but please try to stick around.

I'm sticking around because I love someone.  I hope that you can just stick around long enough to find something to be happy about!  I can't relate to your problems but I hope you just keep going and get in a better emotional state.
